item.title: Sheriff warns of scam texts citing fake Illinois law targeting residents
item.description: JOHNSON COUNTY, Ill. (KBSI) — The Johnson County Sheriff’s Office is warning residents about a recent surge in suspicious text messages attempting to scam recipients by threatening legal or collection action. Authorities said the messages reference a fake statute, “Illinois Administrative Code, Section 15C-16.003,” which does not exist. item.title: Perry County hosts annual Government Day for local students
item.description: PERRY COUNTY, Mo. item.title: No injuries reported in Christopher house fire, officials say
item.description: CHRISTOPHER, Ill. (KBSI) — Fire crews responded to a working fire Monday morning at a residence on South Mulkey Street in Christopher, according to the Benton Fire Department. Benton Truck 805 assisted at the scene of the fire at 608 S. Mulkey St. Officials said no injuries were reported. Categories: News Tags: benton, Benton Fire Department, Christopher, Illinois
